title: Russia says IAEA mission arrives at nuclear plant in Ukraine through Russia
description: Russian troops seized the Zaporizhzhia plant, Europe's largest with six reactors, in the first weeks of their February 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine. It produces no electricity at the moment.

title: The Trump-Zelensky meeting explained
description: President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky simply do not agree on what security agreements are necessary for a ceasefire with Russia.

title: Starmer-Zelenskiy Summit Highlights UK’s Unwavering Support for Ukraine
description: In London, Prime Minister Keir Starmer warmly welcomed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy after tense talks with U.S. President Donald Trump. Britain reassures its steadfast support as Zelenskiy prepares for a European summit and a meeting with King Charles amidst the ongoing Ukraine-Russia conflict.

title: What happened before Trump, Zelenskyy engaged in the Oval Office shouting match
description: What happened with Trump and Zelenskyy at the White House? The Oval Office meeting surrounding the Russia-Ukraine war shifted as the event went on.

title: Trump objected to Zelenskyy disrespect, White House says
description: Zelenskyy challenged the idea that Ukraine can rely on diplomatic guarantees by Russia, whose leader Vladimir Putin launched the war in 2022.

title: Zelenskiy's Diplomatic Tour: A Royal Meeting Amid Geopolitical Tensions
description: Volodymyr Zelenskiy meets UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and plans to visit King Charles amid tensions after Donald Trump threatened to withdraw U.S. support for Ukraine. European leaders expressed unwavering support for Zelenskiy, showcasing a divide between the U.S. and Europe over Ukraine's war with Russia.

title: Diplomacy in Crisis: Restoring Ukrainian-US Ties Amid Conflict
description: NATO chief Mark Rutte urges Ukrainian President Zelenskiy to repair relations with U.S. President Trump after a clash over handling Russia's invasion. Rutte emphasizes the importance of U.S. support, highlighting past military assistance, and stresses global unity in seeking peace for Ukraine.

title: Ukrainians reel from crisis in U.S. ties after Trump-Zelensky clash in the Oval Office
description: Friday’s confrontation flared over differing visions of how to end the three-year-old invasion, with the Ukrainian President seeking strong security guarantees from a Trump administration that has embraced diplomacy with Russia

title: ‘A bigger victory for Putin than any military battle’: Russia gleeful after Trump-Zelenskyy clash
description: Putin stays silent but Russian politicians and media outlets crow with delight after the ambush of Ukraine’s leader

title: Russia says its Ukraine goals will 'not change' after Zelenskyy-Trump spat
description: Earlier today, Dmitry Medvedev, the deputy head of Russia's Security Council and a former Russian president called the Ukrainian president an "insolent pig" who got a "proper slap" in the Oval Office
